name: task_spawn
description: Spawn 1-8 independent tasks asynchronously. Use `task_status` for a non-blocking progress snapshot (phase, updates, last activity), `task_wait` only when blocked on a result, and `task_integrate` after delivery. Do not duplicate a branch still reporting recent activity; if genuinely stalled, take a `task_status` snapshot before taking over. Use synchronous `task` only for one result needed immediately. Top-level agents only.
first_use_guidance:
Guidance for later task_spawn calls in this turn:
- A per-item spawn failure has status 'failed' with no task_id; only wait on returned task_ids.
- After spawn, call `task_status` for non-blocking progress; recent `last activity` means the branch is still working.
- Do not start overlapping work on a delegated branch; if taking over after a stalled snapshot, leave the branch running and stay non-overlapping unless it failed or its scope changed.
- `task_wait` is blocking and returns progress snapshots on timeout/PARKED; call it only when the next step depends on a result.
- Call `task_integrate` for every delivered result.

description.description: Short description of what this task will do (3-10 words).

prompt.description: Self-contained instructions: goal, scope, relevant context, constraints, and expected output.

agent.description: Optional subagent name (default: auto-select). Omit unless you know the exact name.

model.description: Optional model override. Default: reuse parent model; override only when the subtask is clearly lighter or heavier. Ignored when backend is 'traecli' (use `backend_model` there).

inherit.description: Default 'cwd,skills' (history/memory private; right for workspace-touching steps). Otherwise 'all', 'none', or a comma-separated subset of 'history','memory','cwd','skills' (e.g. "cwd,skills"). 'none' for pure analysis; 'all' only when the subtask needs the full conversation.

response_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema object the subagent's single returned value must match, e.g. {"type": "string"} — not a bare type name. Evidence-gated audit agents reject `response_schema`; call them without one and read the `<audit_report>` envelope from the result.

backend.description: Omit to use the session default chosen by /use ('kernel' or 'traecli'); pass an explicit value only to override it for this call.

backend_model.description: Model for backend 'traecli' (see `traecli models`); ignored otherwise. An explicit value overrides the /use session worker model, then TRAECLI_MODEL, ai.traecli.default_model, and built-in 'gpt-5.5' defaults.

backend_continue_from.description: Continue a previous traecli run: pass the earlier task's `task_id` to resume its traecli session, or a raw traecli session UUID. Only for backend 'traecli'; the referenced run must have completed.
